summary: Multi-lane Moggill Road at a freeway on-ramp; no stopping, no parking.
reasons: No stopping sign at freeway on-ramp

drivers.seclusion: Bush bank on the south side, but the kerb is on a wide arterial junction with the Western Freeway on-ramp.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight onto a multi-lane carriageway with a bike lane or shoulder only; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Heavy multi-lane traffic and an overpass beside it.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign for the freeway on-ramp; no cars parked.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at 2.8 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Open to sun; bush on the south side shades the late afternoon.
